8 API specification
[SWS_Wdg_00172]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00347
⌈If more than one watchdog driver instance exits on an ECU (namely an external and
an internal one) the API names and instance specific type names specified in this
chapter shall be made unique by expansion according to SRS_BSW_00347.⌋
